Discarded, rather than rejected, I should say 😄

We have discussed Nabil Gabol and how his mannerisms have been accurately enacted by Rakesh Bedi, who plays Jameel Jamali. The big reveal at the end of part 2 caused many to revisit old documentaries on Lyari, which feature the IRL Nabil Gabol extensively. A specific attribute about Mr. Gabol, not something commonly associated with Pakistani politicians, was noticed by fans, which they claimed made the ending more plausible. What specific quality/attribute?
